(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][AfterImageBlurStep]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.afterimageBlurStep";

const SFX_URL = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind2.ogg";

// -----------------------------

// Helpers

// -----------------------------

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

function wait(ms) {

return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

}

function resolveTokenEntry(entry) {

if (!entry) return null;

// TokenDocument -> Token placeable

if (entry?.object) return entry.object;

// Token placeable

if (entry?.center && entry?.document) return entry;

if (typeof entry === "string") {

// UUID path

const doc = fromUuidSync?.(entry);

if (doc?.object) return doc.object; // TokenDocument

if (doc?.center && doc?.document) return doc; // Token placeable

if (doc?.documentName === "Actor") {

return doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

if (doc?.actor?.getActiveTokens) {

return doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

// Scene token id fallback

const sceneTok = canvas.tokens?.get?.(entry);

if (sceneTok) return sceneTok;

}

return null;

}

function resolveSourceToken() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const candidates = [

p?.sourceToken,

p?.casterToken,

p?.token,

p?._sourceToken,

p?.meta?.sourceToken,

p?.meta?.casterToken,

p?.action?.sourceToken,

p?.action?.casterToken,

p?.sourceTokenUuid,

p?.casterTokenUuid,

p?.tokenUuid,

p?.tokenUUID,

p?.attackerUuid,

p?.attackerUUID,

p?.meta?.attackerUuid,

p?.meta?.attackerUUID

].filter(Boolean);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const out = [];

// Best source: handler already normalized these

if (Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) {

for (const entry of globalThis.__TARGETS) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(entry);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

}

const arrs = [

p?.targets,

p?.targetTokens,

p?.meta?.targets,

p?.meta?.targetTokens,

p?.targetTokenUuids,

p?.originalTargetUUIDs,

p?.targetTokenIds

].filter(a => Array.isArray(a));

for (const arr of arrs) {

for (const entry of arr) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(entry);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

}

// Deduplicate

const seen = new Set();

return out.filter(tok => {

const key = tok?.document?.uuid ?? tok?.id;

if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;

seen.add(key);

return true;

});

}

const sourceToken = resolveSourceToken();

const targets = resolveTargets();

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found in action payload.");

return;

}

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.warn("Sequencer is not active.");

return;

}

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.warn("ONI Pseudo Animation API is not available.");

return;

}

// -----------------------------

// Timing / tuning

// -----------------------------

const params = {

amplitude: 70, // how far left/right the blur dash goes

swings: 7, // number of side-to-side passes

swingMs: 55, // time per pass

afterimageEveryMs: 35, // how often to stamp an afterimage

afterimageFadeMs: 240, // ghost fade duration

disappearFadeMs: 120, // fast vanish at the end

hiddenHoldMs: 140, // brief empty beat before return

returnFadeMs: 520, // slow fade back in

blurStrength: 12,

zMain: 5000,

zGhost: 4990

};

const totalMs =

(params.swings * params.swingMs) +

params.disappearFadeMs +

params.hiddenHoldMs +

params.returnFadeMs + 120;

const scriptSource = `

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][AfterImageBlurStep]";

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

function easeOutCubic(t) {

return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

}

function easeInOutSine(t) {

return -(Math.cos(Math.PI * t) - 1) / 2;

}

function animateValue(from, to, durMs, onUpdate, easing = easeInOutSine) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const tick = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easing(t);

const value = from + (to - from) * e;

onUpdate(value, t);

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(tick);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(tick);

});

}

async function fadeSprite(sprite, from, to, durMs, easing = easeOutCubic) {

await animateValue(from, to, durMs, (value) => {

sprite.alpha = value;

}, easing);

}

async function createClone(token, alpha = 1) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

sprite.alpha = alpha;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = baseObj.width;

sprite.height = baseObj.height;

sprite.angle = baseObj.angle ?? 0;

sprite.scale.x = baseObj.scale?.x ?? sprite.scale.x;

sprite.scale.y = baseObj.scale?.y ?? sprite.scale.y;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zMain ?? 5000);

// Keep horizontal flip if token is flipped

const texScaleX = token.document.texture?.scaleX ?? 1;

const texScaleY = token.document.texture?.scaleY ?? 1;

sprite.scale.x *= Math.sign(texScaleX || 1);

sprite.scale.y *= Math.sign(texScaleY || 1);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

async function spawnAfterimage(mainSprite, ghostBag) {

const ghost = new PIXI.Sprite(mainSprite.texture);

ghost.anchor.set(mainSprite.anchor.x, mainSprite.anchor.y);

ghost.x = mainSprite.x;

ghost.y = mainSprite.y;

ghost.width = mainSprite.width;

ghost.height = mainSprite.height;

ghost.alpha = 0.34;

ghost.angle = mainSprite.angle;

ghost.scale.x = mainSprite.scale.x;

ghost.scale.y = mainSprite.scale.y;

ghost.zIndex = Number(params.zGhost ?? 4990);

if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

ghost.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(3)];

}

canvas.stage.addChild(ghost);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

ghostBag.push(ghost);

fadeSprite(

ghost,

ghost.alpha,

0,

Number(params.afterimageFadeMs ?? 240),

easeOutCubic

).then(() => {

try {

if (ghost.parent) ghost.parent.removeChild(ghost);

ghost.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

});

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

let mainSprite = null;

let returnSprite = null;

const ghosts = [];

let stampTimer = null;

try {

mainSprite = await createClone(casterToken, 1);

if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

mainSprite.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(Number(params.blurStrength ?? 12))];

}

// Hide real token locally while pseudo animation runs

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const leftX = home.x - Number(params.amplitude ?? 70);

const rightX = home.x + Number(params.amplitude ?? 70);

const swings = Number(params.swings ?? 7);

const swingMs = Number(params.swingMs ?? 55);

stampTimer = setInterval(() => {

try {

if (mainSprite) spawnAfterimage(mainSprite, ghosts);

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "afterimage spawn failed:", err);

}

}, Number(params.afterimageEveryMs ?? 35));

// Start from center, then rapidly sway left/right

let currentX = home.x;

let dir = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < swings; i++) {

const targetX = dir === -1 ? leftX : rightX;

await animateValue(currentX, targetX, swingMs, (value) => {

if (mainSprite) {

mainSprite.x = value;

mainSprite.y = home.y;

}

});

currentX = targetX;

dir *= -1;

}

// Snap back to center before vanish

await animateValue(currentX, home.x, Math.max(35, Math.floor(swingMs * 0.8)), (value) => {

if (mainSprite) {

mainSprite.x = value;

mainSprite.y = home.y;

}

});

if (stampTimer) {

clearInterval(stampTimer);

stampTimer = null;

}

// Stronger blur right before vanish

if (mainSprite && PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

mainSprite.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(Number(params.blurStrength ?? 12) + 4)];

}

await fadeSprite(

mainSprite,

mainSprite?.alpha ?? 1,

0,

Number(params.disappearFadeMs ?? 120),

easeOutCubic

);

if (mainSprite) {

if (mainSprite.parent) mainSprite.parent.removeChild(mainSprite);

mainSprite.destroy();

mainSprite = null;

}

// Brief gap where caster is "gone"

await wait(Number(params.hiddenHoldMs ?? 140));

// Return image fades back in at exact home position

returnSprite = await createClone(casterToken, 0);

if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

returnSprite.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(1.5)];

}

returnSprite.x = home.x;

returnSprite.y = home.y;

await fadeSprite(

returnSprite,

0,

1,

Number(params.returnFadeMs ?? 520),

easeOutCubic

);

// Small settle

if (returnSprite?.filters) returnSprite.filters = [];

await wait(40);

} finally {

try {

if (stampTimer) clearInterval(stampTimer);

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (mainSprite) {

if (mainSprite.parent) mainSprite.parent.removeChild(mainSprite);

mainSprite.destroy();

}

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (returnSprite) {

if (returnSprite.parent) returnSprite.parent.removeChild(returnSprite);

returnSprite.destroy();

}

} catch (_) {}

try {

for (const g of ghosts) {

if (!g) continue;

if (g.parent) g.parent.removeChild(g);

g.destroy();

}

} catch (_) {}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

try {

console.log(TAG, "START", { sourceToken, targets });

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// SFX only through Sequencer

await new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SFX_URL)

.volume(0.85)

.play();

// Visuals through Pseudo only

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: targets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params,

meta: { source: "AfterImageBlurStep" }

});

// Wait for the pseudo session to finish before ending the cinematic window

await wait(totalMs);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);

} finally {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

}

})();

}

async function applyConditionToTargets(effectUuid, hitTargets, origin) {

const effectData = await makeEffectData(effectUuid, origin);

const effectName = String(effectData.name ?? effectData.label ?? "").trim();

const results = [];

for (const target of hitTargets) {

const targetActor = await resolveActor(target.uuid);

if (!targetActor) {

results.push({ target: target.name, ok: false, reason: "target_actor_not_found" });

continue;

}

const already = targetActor.effects?.some(e => {

const sameName = effectName && lc(e.name ?? e.label) === lc(effectName);

const sameSource = String(e.flags?.world?.warningShotSourceEffectUuid ?? "") === String(effectUuid);

return sameName || sameSource;

});

if (already) {

results.push({ target: targetActor.name, ok: true, skipped: true, reason: "already_has_effect" });

continue;

}

await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [

foundry.utils.deepClone(effectData)

]);

results.push({ target: targetActor.name, ok: true, effect: effectName });

}

return results;

}

async function applyMpLossThroughAdvanceDamage(hitTargets, mpLoss, attackerActor, sourcePayload) {

const targetIds = uniq(hitTargets.map(t => t.tokenId).filter(Boolean));

if (!targetIds.length) {

throw new Error("No token IDs found for AdvanceDamage MP loss.");

}

const ADV = game.macros.getName("AdvanceDamage");

if (!ADV) {

throw new Error('Macro "AdvanceDamage" not found.');

}

const attackerUuid =

attackerActor?.uuid ??

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

null;

const damageBatchId = firstNonBlank(

p?.meta?.damageBatchId,

p?.damageBatchId,

sourcePayload?.meta?.damageBatchId,

sourcePayload?.damageBatchId

);

const payload = {

targetIds,

baseValue: String(mpLoss),

bonus: 0,

reduction: 0,

multiplier: 100,

valueType: "mp",

elementType: "mp",

weaponType: "none_ef",

attackerUuid,

attackerName: attackerActor?.name ?? "Warning Shot",

attackRange: "Ranged",

sourceType: "Warning Shot",

actionContext: p,

actionCardMsgId: args?.chatMsgId ?? p?.meta?.actionCardMessageId ?? null,

damageBatchId: damageBatchId || null,

battleLogBatchId: damageBatchId || null

};

const prevAuto = globalThis.__AUTO;

const prevPayload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

try {

globalThis.__AUTO = true;

globalThis.__PAYLOAD = payload;

await ADV.execute({

__AUTO: true,

__PAYLOAD: payload

});

} finally {

if (prevAuto === undefined) delete globalThis.__AUTO;

else globalThis.__AUTO = prevAuto;

if (prevPayload === undefined) delete globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

else globalThis.__PAYLOAD = prevPayload;

}

return { ok: true, targetIds, mpLoss };

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Resolve reaction user

// --------------------------------------------------

const attackerUuid = firstNonBlank(

p?.meta?.attackerUuid,

p?.attackerUuid

);

const attackerDoc = await resolveDoc(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve Warning Shot user.", { attackerUuid });

return context?.cancelPipeline?.(

"Warning Shot failed: could not resolve the reacting actor.",

{ notify: true }

);

// --------------------------------------------------

// Read stored choice

const choice = lc(p?.meta?.warningShotChoice);

const skillLevel = Math.max(1, parseInt(p?.meta?.warningShotSkillLevel ?? 1, 10) || 1);

const mpLoss = Math.max(0, Number(p?.meta?.warningShotMpLoss ?? skillLevel * 10) || 0);

if (!["shaken", "slow", "mp_burn"].includes(choice)) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing or invalid Warning Shot choice.", { choice, meta: p.meta });

return context?.cancelPipeline?.(

"Warning Shot failed: missing selected mode.",

{ notify: true }

);

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Re-read and re-validate triggering action

// --------------------------------------------------

const sourceRef = readSourceActionRef();

if (!sourceRef.actionCardId) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing triggering Action Card ID.", sourceRef);

return context?.cancelPipeline?.(

"Warning Shot failed: no triggering Action Card found.",

{ notify: true }

);

}

const sourcePayload = await findSourceActionPayload({

actionCardId: sourceRef.actionCardId,

actionId: sourceRef.actionId,

actionCardMessageId: sourceRef.actionCardMessageId,

fallbackActionContext: sourceRef.actionContext

});

const source = sourcePayload ?? sourceRef.actionContext ?? {};

const rangedInfo = await isRangedAttack(source, sourceRef.phase);

if (!rangedInfo.ok) {

console.warn(TAG, "Resolution blocked: source is no longer a ranged attack.", rangedInfo);

"Warning Shot failed: the triggering action is no longer a ranged attack.",

{ notify: true }

);

if (!hasDamage(source)) {

console.warn(TAG, "Resolution blocked: source no longer has damage.", { source });

return context?.cancelPipeline?.(

"Warning Shot failed: the triggering action no longer has damage.",

{ notify: true }

);

const hitTargets = await getHitTargets(source, sourceRef.phase);

if (!hitTargets.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "Resolution blocked: source would no longer hit.", { source });

"Warning Shot failed: the triggering action would no longer hit.",

{ notify: true }

);

// --------------------------------------------------

const actionEditor = getActionEditorApi();

if (!actionEditor || typeof actionEditor.editActionCard !== "function") {

console.warn(TAG, "Action Editor API is unavailable.");

return context?.cancelPipeline?.(

"Warning Shot failed: Action Editor API is unavailable.",

{ notify: true }

);

// Safety check: this script needs the updated PatchEngine operation.

? patchEngine.SEMANTIC_OPERATION_TYPES

: [];

if (!semanticOps.includes("setDamagePreview")) {

console.warn(TAG, "PatchEngine is missing setDamagePreview operation.", {

patchEngine,

semanticOps

});

return context?.cancelPipeline?.(

"Warning Shot failed: Action Editor PatchEngine is missing setDamagePreview. Please update actionEditor-PatchEngine.js first.",

{ notify: true }

);

}

const modeLabel =

choice === "shaken" ? "Inflict Shaken" :

choice === "slow" ? "Inflict Slow" :

`Lose ${mpLoss} MP`;

const reason = `Warning Shot changed the triggering attack damage preview to 0 and chose: ${modeLabel}.`;

const editResult = await actionEditor.editActionCard({

actionCardId: sourceRef.actionCardId,

actionCardMessageId: sourceRef.actionCardMessageId || null,

actionId: sourceRef.actionId || null,

editorActorUuid:

p?.meta?.warningShotEditorActorUuid ??

attackerActor?.uuid ??

attackerUuid ??

null,

reason,

rebuild: true,

notify: true,

edits: {

operations: [

{

type: "setDamagePreview",

// Main displayed base number and resolution-facing base value.

value: "0",

// Warning Shot fully neutralizes the triggering damage display.

hrBonus: 0,

bonus: 0,

reduction: 0,

// Keep multiplier neutral. The current renderer treats multiplier 0 as fallback 100.

multiplier: 100

},

{

value: `Warning Shot: damage preview set to 0; ${modeLabel}`

});

if (!editResult?.ok) {

console.warn(TAG, "Action Card edit failed.", {

sourceRef,

choice,

modeLabel,

editResult

});

return context?.cancelPipeline?.(

"Warning Shot failed: could not edit the triggering Action Card.",

{ notify: true }

);

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Apply selected Warning Shot result

// --------------------------------------------------

let applyResult = null;

if (choice === "shaken") {

applyResult = await applyConditionToTargets(

SHAKEN_UUID,

hitTargets,

p?.skillUuid ?? p?.skill_uuid ?? null

);

}

if (choice === "slow") {

applyResult = await applyConditionToTargets(

SLOW_UUID,

hitTargets,

p?.skillUuid ?? p?.skill_uuid ?? null

);

}

if (choice === "mp_burn") {

applyResult = await applyMpLossThroughAdvanceDamage(

hitTargets,

mpLoss,

attackerActor,

source

);

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Debug markers

// --------------------------------------------------

p.meta.warningShotAppliedChoice = choice;

p.meta.warningShotAppliedModeLabel = modeLabel;

p.meta.warningShotEditedActionCardId = editResult?.actionCardId ?? sourceRef.actionCardId;

p.meta.warningShotEditedMessageId =

editResult?.messageId ??

editResult?.actionCardMessageId ??

sourceRef.actionCardMessageId ??

null;

p.meta.warningShotAppliedTargets = hitTargets.map(t => ({

name: t.name,

uuid: t.uuid,

actorUuid: t.actorUuid,

tokenId: t.tokenId,

defense: t.defense

}));

p.meta.warningShotRangeRaw = rangedInfo.rangeRaw;

p.meta.warningShotWeaponName = rangedInfo.weaponName ?? null;

p.meta.warningShotWeaponUuid = rangedInfo.weaponUuid ?? null;

args.warningShotApplied = true;

args.warningShotAppliedChoice = choice;

args.warningShotAppliedModeLabel = modeLabel;

console.log(TAG, "Warning Shot applied successfully.", {

actor: attackerActor.name,

choice,

modeLabel,

skillLevel,

mpLoss,

rangedInfo,

hitTargets,

editResult,

applyResult

});

// ============================================================================

// Barrage (Self-Buff) - Sequencer (Pipeline Version)

// - Uses __PAYLOAD from your Action System when available

// - Emits oni:animationStart / oni:animationEnd so your pipeline can track it

//

// Flow

// 1) Play Boon FX ABOVE the caster + SFX

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[Barrage]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

// --- Resolve caster from pipeline ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

// Fallback for testing

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Barrage: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "skillBarrage",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [sourceToken.id], // self-buff

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Assets ---

const FX_BOON =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Conditions/Boon02/ConditionBoon02_001_Refraction_600x600.webm";

const SFX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/EXSkill.ogg";

// --- MAIN SEQUENCE ---

const seq = new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SFX)

.volume(0.95)

// FX above caster

.effect()

.file(FX_BOON)

.atLocation(sourceToken, { offset: { x: 0, y: -80 } }) // "above" (tweak if needed)

.scaleToObject(1.7)

.opacity(1.0)

.belowTokens(false)

.waitUntilFinished();

await seq.play();

// --- Broadcast end ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "skillBarrage",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [sourceToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "skillBarrage", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

// PSEUDO MASTER (ALL visuals)

const pseudoMaster = `

function easeInOutCubic(t){

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animateNumber(setter, from, to, durMs){

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const tick = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / Math.max(1, durMs);

const t = clamp(raw, 0, 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

setter(from + (to - from) * e);

if (t >= 1) { canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick); resolve(); }

};

canvas.app.ticker.add(tick);

});

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs){

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const tick = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / Math.max(1, durMs);

const t = clamp(raw, 0, 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) { canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick); resolve(); }

};

canvas.app.ticker.add(tick);

});

}

props.animation_script:
(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][RunFront-SFX-Return]";

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const DEBUG = true;

const SOUND_SRC = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_manto.wav";

const SOUND_VOLUME = 0.5;

const MOVE_OUT_MS = 320;

const HOLD_MS = 1500; // wait after SFX before running back

const MOVE_BACK_MS = 320;

const APPROACH_GAP = 70;

function dbg(...args) {

if (!DEBUG) return;

console.log(TAG, ...args);

}

function warn(...args) {

console.warn(TAG, ...args);

}

function err(...args) {

console.error(TAG, ...args);

}

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, eventPayload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, eventPayload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload: eventPayload });

};

}

async function toTokenPlaceable(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref === "string") {

const byId = canvas.tokens?.get(ref);

if (byId) return byId;

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

return doc.object ?? doc.token?.object ?? doc;

} catch (e) {

warn("toTokenPlaceable failed fromUuid:", ref, e);

return null;

}

}

return ref.object ?? ref.token?.object ?? ref ?? null;

}

function uniq(arr) {

return [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean))];

}

function summarizeToken(tok) {

if (!tok) return null;

return {

id: tok.id ?? null,

name: tok.name ?? tok.document?.name ?? null,

uuid: tok.document?.uuid ?? null,

center: tok.center ? { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y } : null,

x: tok.x ?? null,

y: tok.y ?? null

};

}

async function resolveSourceToken() {

const candidates = [

payload.casterTokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenUuid,

payload.performerTokenUuid,

payload.tokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenId,

payload.casterTokenId,

globalThis._token?.document?.uuid,

globalThis.token?.document?.uuid

];

dbg("resolveSourceToken candidates:", candidates);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveTargetTokens() {

const raw = uniq([

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetTokenUuids) ? payload.targetTokenUuids : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetUUIDs) ? payload.targetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.originalTargetUUIDs) ? payload.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targets) ? payload.targets : []),

...(Array.from(game.user?.targets ?? []).map(t => t?.document?.uuid))

]);

dbg("resolveTargetTokens raw refs:", raw);

const out = [];

for (const r of raw) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(r);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

return out;

}

let resolvedSourceToken = null;

let resolvedTargets = [];

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();

const targets = await resolveTargetTokens();

const firstTarget = targets[0] ?? null;

resolvedSourceToken = sourceToken;

resolvedTargets = targets;

dbg("Resolved source token:", summarizeToken(sourceToken));

dbg("Resolved targets:", targets.map(summarizeToken));

dbg("Payload snapshot:", payload);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found.");

return;

}

if (!firstTarget) {

ui.notifications.warn("No target token found.");

return;

}

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function getNativeFlipX(token) {

const values = [

token?.document?.texture?.scaleX,

token?.mesh?.scale?.x,

token?.icon?.scale?.x

].filter(v => typeof v === "number");

if (values.some(v => v < 0)) return true;

const mirrorX = token?.document?.texture?.mirrorX;

if (typeof mirrorX === "boolean") return mirrorX;

return false;

}

function setSpriteFlipX(sprite, flipped) {

const sx = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

sprite.scale.x = flipped ? -sx : sx;

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const home = { x: token.center.x, y: token.center.y };

sprite.x = home.x;

sprite.y = home.y;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

sprite.alpha = baseObj.worldAlpha ?? 1;

sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zIndex ?? 5000);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, getNativeFlipX(token));

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const originalFlipX = getNativeFlipX(casterToken);

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

const target = targetTokens?.[0] ?? null;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

let front = {

x: home.x + Number(params.fallbackDx ?? -120),

y: home.y

};

if (target) {

const targetCenter = target.center ?? { x: home.x, y: home.y };

const approachDir = home.x >= targetCenter.x ? 1 : -1;

const gap = Number(

params.approachGap ??

Math.max(casterToken.w ?? 100, target.w ?? 100) * 0.6

);

front = {

x: targetCenter.x + (approachDir * gap),

y: targetCenter.y

};

}

// Run in

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

home,

front,

Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

// Hold while the external SFX window plays

if (Number(params.holdMs ?? 0) > 0) {

await wait(Number(params.holdMs ?? 0));

}

// Flip for the run back

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, !originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

front,

home,

Number(params.moveBackMs ?? params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy();

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

dbg("Starting pseudo movement session.");

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn.flipAware",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [firstTarget.document.uuid],

params: {

moveOutMs: MOVE_OUT_MS,

holdMs: HOLD_MS,

moveBackMs: MOVE_BACK_MS,

approachGap: APPROACH_GAP,

fallbackDx: sourceToken.center.x >= firstTarget.center.x ? -120 : 120,

zIndex: 5000

},

meta: {

source: "RunFrontSfxReturn",

soundSrc: SOUND_SRC

}

});

// Sequencer handles SFX only.

dbg("Starting Sequencer SFX.");

const sfxSeq = new Sequence();

sfxSeq

.wait(MOVE_OUT_MS)

.sound()

.file(SOUND_SRC)

.volume(SOUND_VOLUME);

sfxSeq.play();

// Wait for the whole cinematic window before ending.

await wait(MOVE_OUT_MS + HOLD_MS + MOVE_BACK_MS + 80);

dbg("Animation wait window finished.");

} catch (e) {

err("Animation crashed:", e);

} finally {

try {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

dbg("Emitted oni:animationEnd.", {

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id)

});

} catch (e) {

err("Failed to emit animationEnd:", e);

}

}

})();
props.custom_logic_resolution:
// ============================================================================

// Soul Steal — Custom Logic (Resolution) v8

// UPDATE:

// - Supports a global "(Empty)" item result.

// - Empty result is detected by:

// 1) exact UUID match: Item.SUYqRKHBGXUhiOL1

// 2) resolved item doc name == "(Empty)"

// 3) raw loot text == "(Empty)"

// - If empty result is picked:

// -> route to "Nothing to steal"

// -> STILL mark target as stolen = true

// - Otherwise keep normal steal behavior the same.

// ============================================================================

const TAG = "[ONI][SoulSteal][CL-RES]";

const DEBUG = true;

const EMPTY_ITEM_UUID = "Item.SUYqRKHBGXUhiOL1";

const EMPTY_ITEM_NAME = "(Empty)";

const log = (...a) => DEBUG && console.log(TAG, ...a);

const warn = (...a) => DEBUG && console.warn(TAG, ...a);

const err = (...a) => DEBUG && console.error(TAG, ...a);

function toNum(v, fallback = 0) {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

}

function parseWeight(v) {

if (typeof v === "number") return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0;

if (typeof v === "string") {

const m = v.match(/-?\d+(\.\d+)?/);

return m ? toNum(m[0], 0) : 0;

}

return 0;

}

function safeName(doc, fallback = "—") {

return (doc?.name ?? doc?.actor?.name ?? fallback);

}

function extractItemIdFromUuidLike(s) {

const str = String(s ?? "");

const m = str.match(/\.Item\.([A-Za-z0-9]{10,})$/);

if (m) return m[1];

if (/^[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}$/.test(str)) return str;

return null;

}

function looksLikeResolvableUuid(s) {

const str = String(s ?? "").trim();

if (!str) return false;

// Good enough for ItemTransferCore.resolveItem via fromUuid:

// Actor.X.Item.Y, Item.Y, Compendium.pack.Item.Y, Scene...Token...Item...

if (str.includes(".Item.") || str.startsWith("Item.") || str.startsWith("Compendium.")) return true;

if (str.startsWith("Actor.") || str.startsWith("Scene.")) return true;

return false;

}

function normalizeEmptyName(s) {

return String(s ?? "")

.trim()

.replace(/\s+/g, " ")

.toLowerCase();

}

function isEmptyStealResult(picked, itemDoc = null) {

const pickedUuid = String(picked?.itemUuid ?? "").trim();

if (pickedUuid === EMPTY_ITEM_UUID) return true;

const docName = normalizeEmptyName(itemDoc?.name);

if (docName === normalizeEmptyName(EMPTY_ITEM_NAME)) return true;

const rawLootName = normalizeEmptyName(picked?.rawLoot);

if (rawLootName === normalizeEmptyName(EMPTY_ITEM_NAME)) return true;

return false;

}

function pickWeighted(entries) {

const total = entries.reduce((s, e) => s + Math.max(0, e.weight), 0);

if (!(total > 0)) return null;

let r = Math.random() * total;

for (const e of entries) {

r -= Math.max(0, e.weight);

if (r <= 0) return e;

}

return entries[entries.length - 1] ?? null;

}

// -------------------------

// Chat card builder (ItemAwarder CSS classes)

// -------------------------

function buildObtainCardHtml(rows) {

const card = document.createElement("div");

card.className = "oni-obtain-card";

for (const r of rows) {

const row = document.createElement("div");

row.className = "oni-obtain-row";

if (r.iconSrc) {

const img = document.createElement("img");

img.className = "oni-obtain-icon";

img.src = r.iconSrc;

img.alt = "";

row.appendChild(img);

} else {

const spacer = document.createElement("div");

spacer.style.width = "32px";

spacer.style.height = "32px";

row.appendChild(spacer);

}

const text = document.createElement("div");

text.className = "oni-obtain-text";

for (const n of (r.textNodes ?? [])) text.appendChild(n);

row.appendChild(text);

card.appendChild(row);

}

return card.outerHTML;

}

function nodeText(s) {

return document.createTextNode(String(s ?? ""));

}

function nodeItalic(s) {

const i = document.createElement("i");

i.textContent = String(s ?? "");

return i;

}

function nodeUuidLink(itemUuid, itemName) {

const span = document.createElement("span");

span.className = "oni-obtain-name";

span.textContent = "@UUID[" + String(itemUuid) + "]{" + String(itemName ?? "Item") + "}";

return span;

}

async function postObtainStyle(rows) {

const rawHtml = buildObtainCardHtml(rows);

// Ensure @UUID is enriched into a clickable link

const html = await TextEditor.enrichHTML(rawHtml, { async: true });

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

speaker: null,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

flags: { core: { cssClass: "oni-obtain-msg" } }

});

}

async function postMissCannotSteal() {

}

async function postNothingToSteal() {

}

async function postStoleItem(itemUuid, itemName, itemImg) {

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: itemImg || null,

textNodes: [nodeText("Stole "), nodeUuidLink(itemUuid, itemName)]

}]);

}

// -------------------------

// Loot UUID resolver

// -------------------------

function resolveTemplateItemUuid(rawLoot, lootMap, targetActor) {

const key = String(rawLoot ?? "").trim();

if (!key) return null;

// 1) Already a real UUID

if (looksLikeResolvableUuid(key)) return key;

// 2) Direct lootMap key -> uuid

const direct = lootMap?.[key]?.uuid;

if (direct && looksLikeResolvableUuid(direct)) return String(direct).trim();

// 3) Try if key is an itemId on targetActor

if (targetActor?.items?.get(key)) return targetActor.items.get(key).uuid;

// 4) Try match by NAME inside lootMap values

if (lootMap) {

const low = normalizeEmptyName(key);

const byName = Object.values(lootMap).find(v =>

normalizeEmptyName(v?.name) === low && v?.uuid

);

if (byName?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(byName.uuid)) return String(byName.uuid).trim();

}

// 5) Try match by NAME on targetActor items

if (targetActor?.items) {

const low = normalizeEmptyName(key);

const it = targetActor.items.find(i => normalizeEmptyName(i?.name) === low);

if (it?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(it.uuid)) return it.uuid;

}

// 6) Try world items by exact name first

if (game?.items?.getName) {

const it = game.items.getName(key);

if (it?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(it.uuid)) return it.uuid;

}

// 7) Try world items by normalized name

if (game?.items) {

const low = normalizeEmptyName(key);

const it = game.items.find(i => normalizeEmptyName(i?.name) === low);

if (it?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(it.uuid)) return it.uuid;

}

return null;

}

// -------------------------

// Resolve payload + args

// -------------------------

const payload = (typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined") ? __PAYLOAD : null;

if (!payload) { err("No __PAYLOAD; abort."); return; }

const args = payload.__confirmArgs ?? {};

log("ARGS keys", Object.keys(args));

const targets = Array.isArray(payload?.targets) ? payload.targets : [];

if (!targets.length) { warn("No targets; nothing to do."); return; }

const attackerUuid = payload?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? args?.attackerUuid ?? null;

if (!attackerUuid) { err("No attackerUuid; abort.", { attackerUuid }); return; }

const targetUuid = targets[0];

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid).catch(() => null);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid).catch(() => null);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

log("START", {

attackerUuid,

attacker: safeName(attackerActor, "Unknown Attacker"),

targetUuid,

target: safeName(targetActor, "Unknown Target"),

});

// -------------------------

// 1) HIT / MISS CHECK (Soul Steal checks Magic Defense)

// -------------------------

const isHealing = /^(heal|healing|recovery|restore|restoration)$/i.test(String(args?.elementType ?? "physical"));

const hasAccuracy = (typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : true;

const accTotal = hasAccuracy ? toNum(args?.accuracyTotal, NaN) : NaN;

const explicitAutoHit =

(args?.autoHit === true) ||

(args?.advPayload?.autoHit === true) ||

(args?.advPayload?.isCrit === true);

const treatAutoHit = (!hasAccuracy) || explicitAutoHit;

function readMagicDefense(props) {

const p = props ?? {};

for (const k of ["magic_defense", "current_mdef", "mdef", "magicDef", "magic_def"]) {

const n = toNum(p[k], NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

}

for (const k of Object.keys(p)) {

if (!/magic/i.test(k)) continue;

if (!/def|resist|mdef/i.test(k)) continue;

const n = toNum(p[k], NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

}

return 0;

}

let isHit = true;

if (!isHealing && !treatAutoHit) {

const tProps = targetActor?.system?.props ?? {};

const mdef = readMagicDefense(tProps);

isHit = (Number.isFinite(mdef) && Number.isFinite(accTotal)) ? (accTotal >= mdef) : true;

log("HITCHECK", { accTotal, mdef, isHit });

} else {

log("HITCHECK", { isHealing, treatAutoHit, hasAccuracy, explicitAutoHit, isHit: true });

}

if (!isHit) {

log("MISS => feedback only");

await postMissCannotSteal();

return;

}

// -------------------------

// Read SL (apply IP after steal section)

// -------------------------

let pendingNewIP = null;

try {

const casterProps = attackerActor?.system?.props ?? {};

const curIP = toNum(casterProps?.current_ip, 0);

const maxIP = toNum(casterProps?.max_ip, curIP);

const soulStealItem =

attackerActor?.items?.find(i => String(i?.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() === "soul steal") ??

attackerActor?.items?.find(i => /soul\s*steal/i.test(String(i?.name ?? ""))) ??

null;

const SL = toNum(soulStealItem?.system?.props?.level, NaN);

const slFinal = Number.isFinite(SL) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(SL)) : 0;

pendingNewIP = Math.min(maxIP, curIP + slFinal);

log("IP (pending)", {

curIP,

maxIP,

SL: slFinal,

pendingNewIP,

soulStealItemId: soulStealItem?.id ?? null

});

} catch (e) {

err("IP read failed", e);

}

// -------------------------

// 2) Steal logic (gmToActor; do NOT remove item from target)

// -------------------------

if (!targetActor) {

warn("Target actor not resolved; cannot steal.");

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const tProps = targetActor.system?.props ?? {};

const alreadyStolen = !!tProps?.isStolen;

if (alreadyStolen) {

log("Target already isStolen => Nothing to steal");

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const lootMap = tProps?.stealable_loot ?? {};

const stealTable = tProps?.steal_percentage_table ?? {};

log("STEAL DATA snapshot", {

lootMapKeys: Object.keys(lootMap).length,

stealTableKeys: Object.keys(stealTable).length

});

const entries = [];

const rawRows = Object.values(stealTable ?? {});

log("STEAL TABLE rawRows", rawRows);

for (const row of rawRows) {

if (!row) continue;

if (typeof row === "object" && row.$deleted === true) continue;

let rawLoot = null;

let rawW = null;

if (typeof row === "string") {

rawLoot = row;

rawW = 1;

} else if (Array.isArray(row)) {

rawLoot = row[0];

rawW = row[1];

} else if (typeof row === "object") {

rawLoot = row.loot_id ?? row.lootUuid ?? row.loot_uuid ?? row.uuid ?? row.id ?? null;

rawW = row.loot_percentage ?? row.percentage ?? row.weight ?? row.chance ?? null;

}

const weight = parseWeight(rawW);

const rawLootStr = String(rawLoot ?? "").trim();

const templateUuid = resolveTemplateItemUuid(rawLootStr, lootMap, targetActor);

// HARD GUARD: never allow non-UUIDs into entries

if (!templateUuid || !looksLikeResolvableUuid(templateUuid)) {

warn("STEAL ROW skip (unresolvable loot_id)", { rawLoot: rawLootStr, templateUuid });

continue;

}

if (!(weight > 0)) continue;

entries.push({

itemUuid: templateUuid,

weight,

rawLoot: rawLootStr

});

log("STEAL ROW ok", { rawLoot: rawLootStr, weight, templateUuid });

}

log("STEAL entries parsed", entries);

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const picked = pickWeighted(entries);

if (!picked?.itemUuid) {

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const itemDoc = await fromUuid(picked.itemUuid).catch(() => null);

const itemName = itemDoc?.name ?? "Unknown Item";

const itemImg = itemDoc?.img ?? "";

if (isEmptyStealResult(picked, itemDoc)) {

log("STEAL picked EMPTY result => route to Nothing to steal + mark isStolen", {

pickedItemUuid: picked.itemUuid,

itemName,

rawLoot: picked?.rawLoot

});

try {

await postNothingToSteal();

await targetActor.update({ "system.props.isStolen": true });

log("EMPTY steal handled + isStolen set TRUE");

} catch (e) {

err("EMPTY steal handling failed", e);

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: null,

textNodes: [nodeItalic("Failed to process empty steal (see console)")]

}]);

}

} else {

const itc = window["oni.ItemTransferCore"];

if (!itc?.transfer) {

err('ItemTransferCore missing: window["oni.ItemTransferCore"].transfer');

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: null,

textNodes: [nodeItalic("Failed to steal (ItemTransferCore missing)")]

}]);

} else {

try {

log("GM AWARD begin (gmToActor)", {

templateItemUuid: picked.itemUuid,

receiver: attackerActor.uuid,

itemName

});

await itc.transfer({

mode: "gmToActor",

itemUuid: picked.itemUuid,

quantity: 1,

receiverActorUuid: attackerActor.uuid,

requestedByUserId: game.user?.id,

showTransferCard: false

});

await postStoleItem(picked.itemUuid, itemName, itemImg);

await targetActor.update({ "system.props.isStolen": true });

log("GM AWARD done + isStolen set TRUE");

} catch (e) {

err("GM AWARD failed", e);

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: null,

textNodes: [nodeItalic("Failed to steal (see console)")]

}]);

}

}

}

}

}

}

}

// -------------------------

try {

if (attackerActor && pendingNewIP !== null) {

const curIP2 = toNum(attackerActor.system?.props?.current_ip, 0);

if (pendingNewIP !== curIP2) {

await attackerActor.update({ "system.props.current_ip": pendingNewIP });

log("IP updated", { from: curIP2, to: pendingNewIP });

} else {

log("IP unchanged", { curIP: curIP2 });

}

}

} catch (e) {

err("IP update failed", e);

}
